eligibility.quote: It must be a bug in TF2. When I checked out geometry 1.11.4 the bug was still there, but when I also checked out geometry-experimental 0.5.7 the bug disappeared.

failed_conditions.quote: When running inside rospy, the roscpp client is not initialized and thus ros::ok is false. I'm going to have to think about how to make this work cleanly in both roscpp and rospy. .

resolution.quote: This should be fixed in geometry_experimental 0.5.11
